what_happened: While researching Check J's curated-array fix, found that Check N's existing completeness-net glob '*implementation*agent.md' (lint-agent-contracts.sh, Net 1/Net 2) does not match the '*-implement-agent.md' naming variant (epi-implement-agent.md, founder-implement-agent.md). CHECK_G_EXCLUDED_RELATIVE_PATHS lists epi-implement-agent.md as an exclusion, but Check N's glob never enumerates it, so that exclusion entry is dead code / never actually swept. Not in this task's file_scope to fix (Check N is a different check), but the plan for Check J's own completeness mechanism should avoid the same glob-substring trap by sourcing its base universe from enumerate_dispatchable_agents() (frontmatter-based) rather than a fresh filename glob.

Confirmed a clean, already-proven design for Check J's fix: iterate enumerate_dispatchable_agents() directly (removing the content-gate 'continue'), keep the existing _check_j_locate_handoff_section return-2 ('never write one') skip for research agents unchanged, and add one small EXCLUDED-style curated array (CHECK_J_EXCLUDED_RELATIVE_PATHS, ~8 entries) for forked-subagent-pattern-only agents (meta-builder-agent, spawn-agent, code-reviewer-agent, cslib-vet-agent, document-agent, literature-agent, pptx-assembly-agent, slide-critic-agent) that never reach a skill-orchestrate dispatch[]/aux_dispatch[] row. A mechanical probe of all 81 dispatchable agent files against the real _check_j_locate_handoff_section logic confirmed exactly 44 writers, 23 never-write-one research agents, and 8 no-mention forked-subagent files -- zero currently-misclassified files, so this is a pure drift-closing fix, not a pre-existing-bug fix.

agent 'planner-agent' wrote a .return-meta.json but its terminal write never happened (status=in_progress) and produced no orchestrator handoff — RECORD-TIME CORROBORATION: none found (no commit landed inside the dispatch window and dispatch-strand-probe.sh did not report a stranded heartbeat); this occurrence is not evidence of recoverable, work-intact failure.

Research report had already measured the full 81-file agent population into three justified buckets (44 writers / 23 never-write-one / 8 forked-subagent-only) and named the matching EXCLUDED-style precedent, so the plan phase needed only an independent spot-confirmation of the 8-file exclusion set (re-verified: all 8 have zero handoff-heading and zero string mentions) rather than re-deriving the criterion. Saved roughly an hour of planning measurement.
